items.summary: 游戏网站 Kotaku 编辑表示，自己在 GTA6 中游玩超过 130 小时后，发现仍有部分地点没有在主线剧情中到访，包括动物园和北部的小镇。这名编辑还注意到，地图上至少有两座大型赌场但玩家无法进入，在主线和支线任务中这些赌场也没有被提及或作为任务地点。 斯蒂芬唐金解释称，R 星认为在杰森和露西亚的故事中添加赌场玩法并不合适，尤其需要考虑游戏经济系统的平衡，所以现阶段赌场等确实没有添加到任务中。
items.body:
R星称GTA6地图已经为未来更新预留空间 部分地点可能用于后续内容

https://www.landian.news/archives/128699.html

游戏网站 Kotaku 编辑表示，自己在 GTA6 中游玩超过 130 小时后，发现仍有部分地点没有在主线剧情中到访，包括动物园和北部的小镇。这名编辑还注意到，地图上至少有两座大型赌场但玩家无法进入，在主线和支线任务中这些赌场也没有被提及或作为任务地点。

斯蒂芬唐金解释称，R 星认为在杰森和露西亚的故事中添加赌场玩法并不合适，尤其需要考虑游戏经济系统的平衡，所以现阶段赌场等确实没有添加到任务中。

items.body:
固态硬盘价格出现大幅度下跌：普通用户减少需求叠加云厂商减少企业固态盘采购

https://www.landian.news/archives/128619.html

美国银行发布的数据称，512Gb NAND 晶圆报价降低至 14.30 美元，较 26Q3 下跌达 32%；1Tb NAND 晶圆报价降至 24.90 美元，较 26Q3 下跌达 19%。

对于后续合约价格，美国银行和集邦咨询给出不同的预测，不过都是预测下跌。美国银行预计用于智能手机和电脑的 NAND 闪存价格将在 27Q1 环比下降 5%-10%；集邦咨询则预计 NAND 合约价格从 27Q2 开始下跌。

对于准备购买固态硬盘的消费者来说，闪存报价回落有望逐步缓解购买成本压力，不过成品零售价还受厂商采购合同、现有库存和渠道定价影响，价格下跌时传导可能没有那么快。

items.title: Apple TV becomes the new U.S. home of F1 ACADEMY™, the all-female racing series
items.summary: Apple and F1 ACADEMY™ today announced that the all-female racing series will stream on Apple TV in the United States beginning in 2027.
items.body:
F1 ACADEMY, the all-female racing series dedicated to developing the next generation of talent, comes to Apple TV in 2027, giving U.S. fans more ways to experience the excitement of motorsport.

Apple and F1 ACADEMY™ today announced that the all-female racing series will stream on Apple TV in the United States beginning in 2027. Fans will be able to watch every qualifying session and race throughout the season.1 Entering its fifth season in 2027, F1 ACADEMY is developing the next generation of female racing talent, creating opportunities for women on and off the track, and challenging perceptions of who belongs in motorsport.

The announcement builds on Apple’s growing relationship with Formula 1®, following the global success of Apple Original Films’ blockbuster F1 and the launch of a five-year broadcast partnership that made Apple TV the exclusive U.S. broadcast partner starting in 2026. With its inaugural season of F1 coverage underway, Apple continues to bring fans closer to the sport.

Welcoming F1 ACADEMY to Apple TV in 2027 will give U.S. fans a new way to follow the series and its drivers, further expanding Apple TV’s Formula 1 offerings with more live racing, in-depth programming, and exclusive original content, all complemented by a premium viewing experience with powerful customizable features.

“We have built incredible momentum in the U.S., with a growing and increasingly engaged audience following our drivers and their journeys,” said Susie Wolff, F1 ACADEMY’s managing director. “This landmark partnership with Apple TV in the U.S. marks another important step in the growth of F1 ACADEMY. To have a global brand like Apple recognize the potential of our sport and commit its platform and resources to helping us reach new audiences is a powerful statement of how far we have come and where we are heading. Visibility remains fundamental to our mission. When young girls can switch on their screens and see women racing, competing, and succeeding, it changes what they believe is possible. With Apple TV alongside us, we have an incredible opportunity to build on that momentum and take F1 ACADEMY to the next level in 2027.”

“It’s been incredible to see the excitement around Formula 1 on Apple TV, and we’re thrilled to welcome F1 ACADEMY in 2027,” said Jim DeLorenzo, Apple’s global head of Sports. “These talented young drivers represent the future of motorsport, and we’re excited to give them a bigger platform to share their stories, inspire new fans, and bring even more great racing to viewers on Apple TV.”

“F1 ACADEMY continues to go from strength to strength, and bringing the series to Apple TV in the United States marks another exciting step in its growth,” added Ian Holmes, Formula 1’s chief media rights and broadcasting officer. “Through our broadcast partnership with Apple, we have a fantastic opportunity to bring even more fans closer to the action, showcase the incredible talent and personalities coming through the series, and inspire more women and girls to see a future for themselves in motorsport.”

Since launching in 2022 as a Formula 4-level development series, F1 ACADEMY has rapidly grown in popularity and global reach, becoming the second-most-followed series after Formula 1, according to the 2025 Global F1 Fan Survey. The series has continued to build momentum through an expanding international race calendar and introduced fans to a burgeoning roster of talented young drivers including Alba Hurup Larsen, Alisha Palmowski, and Emma Felbermayr.

Fans in the U.S. can catch all the F1 ACADEMY action exclusively on Apple TV beginning in 2027.

Apple TV offers premium, compelling drama and comedy series, feature films, groundbreaking documentaries, and kids and family entertainment, and is available to watch across all of a user’s favorite screens. After its launch on November 1, 2019, Apple TV became the first all-original streaming service to launch around the world, and has premiered more original hits and received more award recognitions faster than any other streaming service in its debut. To date, Apple Original films, documentaries, and series have been honored with 927 wins and 3,928 award nominations and counting, including multi-Emmy Award-winning and history-making comedies Widow’s Bay, The Studio, and Ted Lasso; global cultural phenomenon Severance; Apple’s most-viewed drama, Pluribus; Academy Award Best Picture winner CODA; and Academy Award winner F1, the highest-grossing sports feature of all time.
